scripts.dev:all: bun run --filter @geto/web dev & cargo run --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml
scripts.codegen:openapi: cargo run --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml -- export-openapi > openapi.json && bunx openapi-typescript openapi.json -o apps/web/src/lib/types/api.d.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server
scripts.docker:build: podman build --target runtime -t geto:latest . && podman images geto:latest --format '📦 Image: {{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} | Size: {{.Size}}'
scripts.docker:build:routeup: podman build --target routeup -t geto:routeup . && podman images geto:routeup --format '📦 Image: {{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} | Size: {{.Size}}'
scripts.docker:export-ca: podman cp $(podman-compose -f docker-compose.routeup.yaml ps -q geto):/root/.routeup/ca.crt ./geto-ca.crt && echo '✅ ca.crt exported to ./geto-ca.crt'
